g.text: Frozen EXP-008 example: information-00, phase 675, norm 0.016, dt=0.005
All four policies select candidate 4; candidate waveforms coincide.
The first declared test origin is retained regardless of qualification or which policy wins. Gray interval: preview 0-75.
Waveforms use the original epoch. Reported RMSE fits one constant phase on its scored interval, separately for each policy.
No frequency fit or time warp. Candidate labels are 0-17; overlapping candidate entries remain separate charged evaluations.
